column1: # Ukrainian word stress that the compiled-in ending/stem statistics get wrong: frequent forms of a Ukrainian text pool for which the en.wiktionary Ukrainian extract (explicit acute accents) gives exactly one stressed vowel and the statistics give another. word<TAB>stress (vowel index from the end, 0 = last). Context-free forms only: forms with two Wiktionary readings are not listed; that needs context. Read before the built-in table and the lexicon, after nothing but the homograph pins.
# Source: en.wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0 / GFDL), accented headwords and inflected forms (kaikki.org extract).
